seo.title: Nami Island by Private Car | Pak Lee's Car
seo.description: A private van and driver to Nami Island, Petite France and the garden. Ten hours, your pace, fuel and tolls included. ₩400,000 per vehicle.

hero.h1: Nami Island, at your own pace
hero.lede: Most tours give you ninety minutes on the island. I park and wait — stay two hours or five. On the way back most people add Petite France, or Myeongdong if there's light left.
hero.heroAlt: Guests on a day trip with Pak Lee

itinerary.title: Your hotel
itinerary.body: I text when I'm downstairs. No meeting point and no waiting in a lobby — we leave from wherever you slept.

itinerary.title: Gapyeong
itinerary.body: About ninety minutes from central Seoul without traffic. Leaving at eight puts us ahead of the tour buses at the ferry pier.

itinerary.title: Nami Island
itinerary.body: I park and wait at the pier. The ferry and island entry are your own ticket, about ₩16,000. Stay as long as you like — I'm not going anywhere.

itinerary.title: Lunch
itinerary.body: I know which places near Gapyeong are actually halal and which only say so. If that doesn't matter to you, the dakgalbi here is worth the stop.

itinerary.title: Petite France or the Garden of Morning Calm
itinerary.body: Both are fifteen minutes from the pier. Pick one on the day — you'll know by then whether you want more walking.

itinerary.title: Back — or not
itinerary.body: Most people add Myeongdong on the way home. That's fine by me, as long as we're inside the ten hours.

faqs.q: Can we change the plan on the day?
faqs.a: Yes. People do it constantly and it costs nothing, as long as we stay within the ten hours.
No. The ferry and island entry are about ₩16,000 per adult and you buy them at the pier. I'll show you where.

faqs.q: Will eight people and luggage fit?
faqs.a: Eight people fit. Eight people with large suitcases do not — at six or more I'd bring cabin bags rather than full-size cases.

faqs.q: How long is the drive from Seoul?
faqs.a: About ninety minutes each way without traffic. Leaving at eight rather than nine usually saves half an hour.

faqs.q: Is it worth going in winter?
faqs.a: The tree-lined paths look best under snow, but the island is exposed and the wind off the river is cold. Bring more layers than you think.

cta.body: Tell me your date and how many people. I'll say honestly what else fits that day.
